ModMetaData.name: 定制材质动力甲 (Stuffable Power Armor)
ModMetaData.author: UNSCLatios
ModMetaData.description:
Makes imperial and mechanitor power armor stuffable, so the material you build it from matters.
Supported items: recon armor/helmet, marine armor/helmet, cataphract (knight) armor/helmet, prestige recon/marine/cataphract armor and helmets, grenadier armor, locust armor, phoenix armor, mechlord suit, mechlord helmet, and mechcommander helmet.
- Replaces most of the plasteel cost with a material of your choice, while keeping 20 plasteel as the fixed structural requirement. Building from plasteel reproduces the vanilla item exactly. - The strength of the material's effect on the finished armor is configurable from 20% to 100%; the item's material effect multiplier shows the applied percentage. - Choose which material categories are allowed: metals (default), wood, cloth/leather, or stone blocks. - Changes to the percentage or material categories take effect after restarting the game. - Hit-point ratios are preserved when the setting changes or when the cleanup button removes the material. - Existing armor from older saves is treated as plasteel. - A cleanup button in the mod settings clears the material selection on every supported item in the save and tells you when it is safe to remove the mod. - English and Chinese (Simplified) text included.
<size=20>中文说明</size> 让帝国动力装甲与机械师装甲可以使用不同材料制作，材料会实际影响成品属性。
支持物品：斥候装甲/头盔、海军装甲/头盔、骑士装甲/头盔、圣装斥候/海军/骑士装甲及头盔、掷弹装甲、飞蝗装甲、凤凰装甲、机械领主装甲、机械领主头盔、机械指挥官头盔。
- 用自选材料替换装甲中的大部分玻璃钢，但固定保留20个玻璃钢。使用玻璃钢时属性与原版完全一致。 - 材料对成品属性的影响程度可在20%~100%之间调整；物品属性中的“材料效果乘数”会显示实际应用的比例。 - 可选择允许的材料类别：金属（默认）、木头、织物与皮革、石砖。 - 修改材料影响比例或材料类别后，需要重启游戏才会生效。 - 调整材料比例或使用清理按钮移除材料时，会保持物品当前耐久度占最大耐久的比例不变。 - 旧存档中已有的装甲会自动视为玻璃钢材质。 - 模组设置中提供清理按钮，可清除存档中所有受支持护甲的材料选择，并提示何时可以安全移除模组。 - 内置英文与简体中文文本。
